enh.title: Enhancing: what to start with and what it costs
enh.sub: Chance, materials, Cron and durability per step from real item data, checked against 2026 player guides (BlackDesertFoundry Jul 2026, GrumpyGreen Sep 2026).
enh.startTitle: What should a new player enhance first?
enh.planSub: Pick a gear piece, its current level and your target. The page shows the chance, materials and Cron Stones for each step.
enh.fsHelp: Each FS adds 10% of the base chance; armor and weapons slow down past 70%; hard cap 90%.
enh.cronHint: Counts Cron Stones per the BDOCodex table
enh.note: Chances with FS follow the rules below. Since 17 Sep 2026 the in-game enhance window also shows the final chance, so you can compare.
enh.rule1: Each failstack adds 10% of the base chance, e.g. armor +8 at 17.24% gains 1.72% per FS.
enh.rule2: Armor and weapons: once the chance reaches 70%, each FS adds only a fifth of the normal gain, and the cap is always 90%.
enh.rule3: Accessories: soft caps at PRI 18 / DUO 40 / TRI 44 / TET 110 FS; past that each FS adds 2% of the base chance. A failure destroys both accessories.
enh.rule4: From DUO up, a failure drops one level. Cron Stones (3M each from NPCs) prevent it; accessories still have a 40% downgrade chance with Crons.
enh.rule5: Ancient Anvil: each failure adds Agris Essence; when it is full the next attempt is guaranteed.
enh.tuvala: Tuvala: +8 to +15 are high (70% down to 55%), PRI to TRI always succeed, TET is 7% and PEN 5%. Failing TET to PEN drops to TRI and Crons cannot stop it. GrumpyGreen (Sep 2026) recommends FS 60+ and reports about 30% / 35% / 40% at FS 60 / 70 / 80, lower than the general formula in the table, so trust the in-game number. TET armor: after 4 failures the 5th attempt is guaranteed.
